hero.sub: In McHenry County, a lot of plumbing trouble builds slowly: sediment in the water heater, scale in the fixtures or a sump pump that's getting tired. A maintenance visit catches it early. From our office on West Elm Street.

blocks.h2: What a McHenry Plumbing Inspection Covers
blocks.intro: Built around local water and weather:

steps.body: Age, leaks, relief valve, venting and a flush. With hard water, the flush matters most.
Salt, settings and regeneration, plus any iron or sediment filters.
A test cycle, the float, the check valve and the battery backup.
Slow drains, gurgling and a [camera inspection](/mchenry/video-camera-sewer-inspections) if needed.
Scale on fixtures, stiff shutoffs and pinhole leaks.
What's fine, what to plan for and what needs attention.

blocks.intro: Water and weather make regular checkups worth it here.

items.body: Scale builds in water heaters, fixtures and valves every day. Yearly service keeps it from becoming a failure.
A spring visit tests the sump pump and backup before the Fox River and the lakes rise.
About 4 in 10 McHenry homes went up between 1990 and 2009. Their original water heaters, sump pumps and softeners are due for attention.

blocks.h2: Plumbing Maintenance Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: How often should I have my plumbing inspected in McHenry?
items.preview: Once a year, ideally in spring.
items.answer: Once a year is a good rule in McHenry County, where hard water and high water seasons both wear on plumbing. Spring lets us test the sump pump before heavy rain.

items.q: Does a maintenance visit include a water heater flush?
items.preview: It can. With hard water, we usually recommend it.
items.answer: It can, and with McHenry's hard water we usually recommend it. We'll tell you if yours is due.
Yes. We check salt, settings and regeneration, and tell you if the resin or valve needs service.
Yes. The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) is our yearly plan that brings a plumber to your home for regular maintenance.

items.q: Do you check well equipment during maintenance?
items.preview: We check the pressure tank and the plumbing side.
items.answer: We check the pressure tank, the pressure switch setting and the plumbing from the tank into the house. Well pump and well work beyond that may need a well contractor, and we'll tell you if so.

items.q: How much does a plumbing inspection cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the home and what's included. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the size of the home and what's included, like a water heater flush or a sewer camera inspection. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
